paragraphs: Rav Huna’s wife. In [Nazir 57b](https://www.sefaria.org/Nazir.57b.5), Rav Ada bar Ahavah asks Rav Huna, “Who cuts your sons’ hair?” He replies, “Chovah.” In [Bava Kamma 80a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Kamma.80a.13-14), Rav Ada asks Rav Huna who tends his small livestock. He answers, “Chovah.” Rav Ada says, “May Chovah bury her sons.” The account relates that none of Rav Huna’s children by Chovah survived during Rav Ada bar Ahavah’s lifetime.[^1]

notes.text: The curse also occurs in Nazir. Bava Kamma explicitly names Chovah again in the closing statement about Rav Huna’s children.
